model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of different metals – Aluminum, Kupfer (Copper), and Nickel – within the German and European economies from 2021 to 2023. The horizontal axis represents the years 2021, 2022, and 2023, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis displays percentages ranging from 0% to 35%, with a linear scale and tick intervals of 5%.  The left side of the chart represents Germany, with blue bars indicating the percentage of each metal in 2021 (11.3% Aluminum, 8.3% Copper, and 2.2% Nickel), 2022 (11.4% Aluminum, 2.7% Copper, and 4.4% Nickel), and 2023 (25.1% Aluminum, 24.7% Copper, and 11.4% Nickel). The right side of the chart represents the European Union, with light blue bars indicating the percentage of each metal in 2021 (24.3% Aluminum, 1.3% Copper, and 5.1% Nickel), 2022 (23.3% Aluminum, 1.7% Copper, and 1.4% Nickel), and 2023 (25.0% Aluminum, 2.8% Copper, and 4.4% Nickel). All bars are unshaded and appear to be of equal thickness.
